scope: D36: bounded atomic publication retries also handle access-denied failures

libraries.verified: 2026-11-07 D36: .NET filesystem APIs may raise either IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException, and C# catch filters can restrict retry handling to those types (query: "In .NET 10 C#, File.Replace(sourceFileName, destinationFileName, destinationBackupFileName) throws UnauthorizedAccessException versus IOException when destination is in use, locked or pending delete; how should a retry filter catch both and preserve File.Replace then File.Move order?").
